## About
Getting your home remodeled can be stressful. There are lots of decisions to make, and the first one is who you let into your house. We treat each customer's home as if it were our own and work to get every job done right the first time.
Miro walks you through your options, helps you pick cabinets and works through the layout with you until it fits how you live. His crews keep in mind that this is a home first and a job site second. Reviewers have named Christian, Lucas, Andy and Marius for the care they put into the work.
The fly-by-night companies come and go. We are built to last, not for the quick buck. Our Google rating is 5 from 27 reviews, and we'd be glad to talk with you about your project.

## Services
- Kitchen Remodeling: From cabinet layout to finishes, we plan your kitchen with you. One reviewer said Miro worked through different layouts with them until they were happy with it.
- Bathroom Remodeling: Ready to give your bathroom a total makeover? We'll create a brand new sparkling bathroom at a reasonable price.
- Basement Remodeling: Have an unfinished lower level? We can turn it into a cozy and inviting space. One reviewer had framing, flooring, a bathroom, lighting, electric and plumbing hook-up done in theirs.
- Cabinet showroom: Come see cabinets in person at our office on N Pulaski Rd. The showroom is open by appointment.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work in my area?
A: We service the city of Chicago and suburbs, including neighborhoods on the North and Northwest sides and towns in Cook County and Lake County. The full list of service areas is on our About Us page.

Q: Is the quote free?
A: Yes. You can request a free quote through our contact form or by calling us.

Q: Can I visit the cabinet showroom?
A: Yes. The showroom is at our office on N Pulaski Rd and is open by appointment only. Just let us know you'd like to visit when you reach out.

Q: How will you treat my home while you work?
A: We respect your home and do our best to keep noise, dust and disruption down. No honest remodeler can make them disappear entirely, but our crews remember this is your home first.

## What customers say
- "Working with Homewise Remodelers was an amazing experience from bid to finish. My wife and I had just bought a condo 4 months prior. We had bought it knowing that the kitchen and flooring needed to be remodeled. We had never gone through working with a general contractor before so we meticulously researched. Everyone told us that contractors were unreliable, never finish on time, and expect to pay up to 20% over the initial quote.

Going in with this expectation, I spent hours looking for Chicago contractors on Angie's List and Thumbtack. We settled on 7 different contractors to get bids from. The entire job cost was quoted to us from $30,000 to $80,000 depending on the contractor.

Mirek (Homewise Remodeling) was head and feet above all of the other contractors we interviewed in every way. He was the fastest to come in to survey. He was very big picture and honest upfront. His communication skills were unmatched by all of the other contractors we met. He was meticulous with detail and talked us out of doing things in a more expensive way. We received computer comps from the 3 final contractors we liked. Only Mirek's had every single detail we discussed and was spot-on. The others missed half the things we said and worse, their measurements were off.

We initially were thinking of going with the cheapest contractor but quickly realized after talking to them for a week that they were extremely unreliable and were going to likely overcharge things on the back end and not do things correctly (which I found was the case in many of their reviews on Thumbtack. They either asked for more money or quit on the project halfway through). Homewise Remodelers quoted less than the 50th percentile of quote prices. So Homewise was not the cheapest choice but also definitely not even close to the most expensive quote we got. But based on what I know now, it was the best choice in terms of being done right, timely, with the highest quality, and with no surprise costs. You get what you pay for.

When it came to doing the job, Mirek used very thorough and timely subcontractors for flooring. Mirek would frequently show up at our condo to troubleshoot things with the cabinet installation guys. We discovered that the floor-to-ceiling height on one side of our kitchen was 1.5" off from the opposite side. Mirek planned with the carpenters to sightly grade the cabinets across the room in such a way that the counter-tops ended up perfectly balanced across, and appeared flush from floor to ceiling as if the condo was actually built level. The attention to detail was astounding from start to finish.

Homewise Remodelers finished our project 1 week early, for exactly the price quoted (plus $1000) for changes we wanted mid-project), and it came out better than we imagined. Feel free to reach out with me for questions or as a reference for this contractor. We will for sure use this company for all of our future work.

We had such an amazing experience with them that 1.5 years later we knew we had to hire them to do our bathroom renovation as well." (Henry David, 5/5)
